summary: Assembled graph is well-formed and ready for use. All quality checks pass: file-level nodes present with proper prefixes, no duplicate IDs, cross-batch edges properly captured with transitive dependencies documented, all source/target references valid, component hierarchies complete. Import-map recovery successful on critical page→workshop edge. Type system preserves non-standard types (interface, type, const) consistently.

fileLevelNodesPresent.detail: All 14 file-level nodes have proper 'file:' prefix. Batch files (ProTip, StepCard, tiana-ai-positioning-workshop, CodeBlock, TianaSessionFooter, copyWithConfetti, layout, page, globals.css, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.mjs, next.config.ts, next-env.d.ts, .understandignore) accounted for.

nodeIdConsistency.detail: All 34 node IDs are unique and consistent. Merge report's deduplication (23 duplicates removed, last occurrence kept) is reflected. No remaining ID collisions detected.

crossBatchEdges.detail: Cross-batch dependencies present: tiana-ai-positioning-workshop→CodeBlock/ProTip/StepCard (batch 1→3), page→TianaSessionFooter (batch 3→3), page→tiana-ai-positioning-workshop (batch 3→1 via importMap recovery), CodeBlock→copyWithConfetti (batch 3→utility). Transitive dependencies documented (e.g., page→CodeBlock marked 'cross-batch-dependency' with note).

edgeSourceTargetValidity.detail: All 35 edges have valid, non-empty source and target node IDs. No malformed references. Merge report's edge cleanup (30 dropped for empty source/target) is reflected. Every edge references existing nodes.

componentHierarchy.detail: TianaAiPositioningWorkshop component hierarchy fully captured: file-level imports of CodeBlock, ProTip, StepCard (lines 600–622); function-level uses of Section, PromptCard, TeachingCard, StructureCard, BulletList, WorkshopRecordingCard (lines 633–678); usage of LEAVE_WITH const (line 697–702). Sub-components (PromptCard→CodeBlock, TeachingCard/Section/StructureCard→BulletList) also captured.

issues.message: Type system uses non-standard node types (interface, type, const) not in default schema. These are preserved as-is per merge report. Recommendation: map interface→class, type→class, const→module in final schema review, or document these as valid extensions.

Function-level edge missing between HomePage function and TianaAiPositioningWorkshop function. File-level import (page.tsx→tiana-ai-positioning-workshop.tsx) is present and sufficient, but function-level call graph is not captured. This is acceptable if analyzer only tracked file-level imports.

CSS parsing edges use semantic type 'uses-styles' (CodeBlock/TianaSessionFooter→globals.css) rather than 'imports'. This correctly distinguishes runtime style application from module imports; no correction needed.

recommendations: Graph is production-ready. No corrective actions required.
For future batches: consider capturing function-level call edges (HomePage→TianaAiPositioningWorkshop) if higher resolution is needed.
Confirm that type system extension (interface/type/const as node types) aligns with downstream consumer expectations; document if intentional.
Important: edge recovery from importMap (page→tiana-ai-positioning-workshop, line 839) prevented a critical dependency from being lost. Ensure importMap recovery is a standard step in future merges.

edgeRecovery.note: Without recovery, the home page would have appeared to use only TianaSessionFooter and CodeBlock, not the main workshop component. Recovery restored the correct dependency.
